user.title: House Structure

data.plenum_x: Plenum east of the house's south-west corner
data.plenum_y: Plenum north of the house's south-west corner

data_description.rotation: Degrees the house is turned clockwise from true north: the value measured from OpenStreetMap is filled in. Its four faces then look this far past north, east, south and west.
data_description.preview: Tick and press Submit to redraw the map with the rotation typed above. Nothing is saved until you submit with this unticked.
data_description.shade_below: Treat the south-east to south-west sun as blocked by trees and neighbours below this elevation. A wall or roof can set its own.
data_description.below_grade: How far a below-ground room's walls go into the soil, such as 1.8 m or 6 ft, for every basement room that does not give its own. Blank takes the whole wall as below grade.
data_description.unit: Sizes are typed in this unit and kept in metres, so changing it later keeps them. A size typed with its own unit (3.2 m, 12' 6", 14 sq ft) is read in that unit instead. In feet and inches, type lengths like 12' 6" (or 12 6); floor areas and volumes are in square and cubic feet.
data_description.sky_source: Where the sun and sky light comes from. Open-Meteo is fetched over the internet every 15 minutes (no key needed). A solar radiation sensor, such as a weather station's, is read every 5 minutes and split into the sun's beam and the rest of the sky.
data_description.sky_sensor: Only for the sensor source: a sensor reading all the sun and sky light on a flat surface, in W/m².
data_description.duct_sections: One per line: 'Name: segments' for a section off the plenum, or 'Name from Upstream: segments' for one that hangs off another. Segments are written as a register's duct is (no cfm needed: a section carries what the registers behind it need). A register names its upstream section, and its own duct is then only the branch from that section.
data_description.plenum_x: Where the furnace's plenum is on the plan, east of the house's south-west corner (a minus sign for west). The heating runs start here. Blank both east and north to draw no runs.
data_description.plenum_y: Where the plenum is on the plan, north of the house's south-west corner (a minus sign for south).
data_description.plenum_z: How high the plenum is above the ground, for one in a basement or on a floor. Blank: the ground.

data_description.sheet: Paste the sheet here, with its header row, separated by tabs or commas. Submitting it lists the changes; nothing is saved until you accept them.

sheet.title: Check the sheet
sheet.description:
Nothing is saved yet. This sheet would add {added}, change {changed} and remove {removed} parts:{changes}{notes}

Save these changes, or reject them and paste a corrected sheet.

data_description.action: Save the changes, or go back to the house form with the sheet still pasted in it.

user.title: Room

data.name: Name
data.x: East of the house's south-west corner
data.y: North of the house's south-west corner

data_description.name: Leave empty for a name from the room.
data_description.volume: Leave empty for floor area times ceiling height. Give it for a sloped ceiling.
data_description.below_ground: Tick for a basement room: its walls trade heat with the soil.
data_description.beside: Rooms on the same floor that share a wall with this one. A room linked here is linked both ways, so each pair is entered once. When first shown, the other rooms on the same floor are ticked: untick the ones that do not touch.
data_description.above: Rooms over its ceiling (this room is below them). Areas without a room, such as an unheated attic, can be chosen too.
data_description.below_grade: For a basement: how far its walls go into the soil, such as 1.8 m or 6 ft. Blank uses the house's default (now {below_grade_default}); it only counts for a room marked below ground.
data_description.width: The room's length east to west, along its north and south walls. Leave width and depth both empty to draw a square from the floor area; give one, and the other is worked out from the floor area.
data_description.depth: The room's length south to north, along its east and west walls.
data_description.x: Where the room's south-west corner sits on the plan, east of the house's south-west corner (a minus sign for west). Blank: the room is drawn in a row after the others.
data_description.y: Where the room's south-west corner sits on the plan, north of the house's south-west corner (a minus sign for south).
data_description.level: The floor's height above the ground: 0 for the ground floor, about 2.7 m for the one above it, and a minus sign for a basement. Blank: the ground.
data_description.room_type: A hallway or stairs opens onto the rooms beside it: a link to one is an opening with no wall, unless the lists say otherwise.
data_description.open: Rooms beside this one with no wall between, such as an open-plan kitchen. Enter each link once, from either room.
